items.example: He takes tourists around the waterfalls every day.
Then they cross the border to see the water from the other side.
Finally he takes them to do some tax-free shopping.
Go straight on until you hear the music from the square.
Keep going past the cinema and take the first left.

items.idiom: keep going until you reach the end of the road
items.translation: идти, пока не дойдёте до конца дороги
items.example: Keep going for fifteen minutes until you reach the end of the road.
Go past the restaurant and it is on the left.
